headline: Ghana Unveils $10 Billion New Economy Strategy Across Key Sectors
summary: President John Mahama urged businesses to capitalize on Ghana's $10 billion New Economy Programme, while PwC noted that fiscal credibility will depend on sustainable financing mechanisms.
why: Ghana is executing economic reforms following debt restructuring, with state development expenditure critical to stimulating private sector growth.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Large-scale capital deployment into strategic sectors aims to accelerate domestic economic growth.
